Cotonou, Benin · Easter 2026

Easter in Cotonou.

Over Easter 2026, The Tree of LIF joined Église de la Paix du Christ for a multi-day hospital outreach in Cotonou. Volunteers visited patients, offered prayer, and helped families with medical bills.
